blocked-by.dependency: Embeddable Widget Generation - Need widget infrastructure

story-overview.user-story: As a User, I want to restrict which domains can use my widget, so that my bot isn't embedded on unauthorized sites.
story-overview.business-value: Domain whitelisting prevents unauthorized use of chatbots on unintended websites, protecting brand reputation and preventing abuse. Mobile responsiveness ensures widget works seamlessly on smartphones and tablets (>60% of web traffic). Together, these features enable secure, accessible deployment across all devices and controlled distribution.
story-overview.technical-summary: Extend WidgetSettings with domain whitelist UI supporting exact and wildcard domains (*.example.com). Implement server-side origin verification middleware checking Origin/Referer headers against whitelist. Support graceful degradation (empty whitelist = no restrictions). Build mobile-first responsive CSS with touch-friendly UI (44x44px minimum touch targets). Handle mobile keyboard appearance using visualViewport API. Ensure WCAG AA accessibility (4.5:1 contrast, ARIA labels). Test on iOS/Android devices and major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). Optimize for 3G networks (< 50KB bundle, minimized requests).

key-functional-requirements.requirement: Widget works on desktop and mobile browsers

ac.given: I am on the widget settings page
ac.then: - I see a "Allowed Domains" section - An input field to add domains

ac.given: I enter "example.com" in the allowed domains field
ac.when: I click Add or press Enter
ac.then: - "example.com" is added to the list - It appears as a tag/chip in the list

ac.given: I enter "*.example.com" (wildcard)
ac.then: - The wildcard is saved - It allows the widget to load on any subdomain

ac.given: I have multiple domains in the list
ac.then: I see all domains listed with: - Domain name - Edit button (edit the domain) - Delete button (remove the domain)

ac.given: I want to remove a domain
ac.then: - The domain is removed from the whitelist - The updated config is saved

ac.given: I try to add an invalid domain: "not a domain!@#"
ac.then: - An error appears: "Invalid domain format" - The domain is NOT added to the whitelist

ac.given: I try to add "localhost" (for testing)
ac.then: - It's accepted (valid for testing) - Added to the whitelist

ac.given: I try to add a domain twice
ac.then: An error appears: "Domain already in whitelist"

ac.given: A website embeds my widget code
ac.then: - The widget initializes normally - The chat interface appears

ac.given: A website embeds my widget code
ac.when: The widget tries to load on "unauthorized-domain.com"
ac.then: - The widget does NOT load - User sees message: "This widget is not authorized for this domain" - NO chat interface is displayed

ac.given: The domain whitelist is empty (no restrictions)
ac.then: - The widget loads on ANY domain (backward compatible) - A warning appears in bot settings: "No domain restrictions. Widget is publicly accessible."

ac.given: The widget makes a request to load chat
ac.when: The request arrives at the server
ac.then: The server checks: - Origin header or Referer header - Match against configured whitelist - If not in whitelist (and whitelist not empty): return 403 Forbidden - If in whitelist: return 200 OK with chat page

ac.given: A user manually edits widget code to bypass domain check
ac.when: The iframe tries to load chat
ac.then: - The server validates Origin/Referer (not trusting client) - Blocks unauthorized requests

ac.given: The widget is embedded on a mobile website
ac.when: I view the widget on iPhone/Android
ac.then: - The chat interface is fully responsive - Text is readable (no zoom required) - Input field is touch-friendly (44px minimum)

ac.given: I interact with the chat on a mobile device
ac.then: The chat window adjusts: - Shifts up to stay visible above keyboard - Message list scrolls properly - Input remains accessible

ac.given: The widget is on a small mobile screen (360px width)
ac.then: - The chat interface scales appropriately - No horizontal scrolling is needed

ac.given: I rotate my mobile device (portrait ↔ landscape)
ac.then: - The widget adapts to new dimensions - No layout breaks occur

ac.given: I'm using the widget on a mobile device
ac.then: - All buttons and inputs meet 44x44px minimum (WCAG guideline) - Spacing between clickable elements is >= 8px

ac.given: I'm typing a message on mobile
ac.then: The button is large enough (44px) for accurate touch

ac.given: I'm using a screen reader on mobile
ac.then: - All ARIA labels are present and correct - Focus management is logical - Widget works with keyboard navigation

ac.given: I'm on a low-vision mobile setting
ac.then: - Text contrast ratios meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) - Font sizes are readable (min 14px)

ac.given: I embed the widget in various browsers
ac.then: The widget works on: - Chrome/Edge (latest 2 versions) - Firefox (latest 2 versions) - Safari (latest 2 versions, desktop & mobile) - Safari on iOS 14+

ac.given: I use the widget on an older browser (IE11)
ac.then: - Graceful degradation: widget doesn't crash - Fallback message: "This browser is not fully supported"

ac.given: I load the widget on a slow 3G connection
ac.then: - The widget loads within 3 seconds - Chat interface appears (possibly with placeholder) - User can start typing while chat connects

ac.given: I'm on a mobile device with limited data
ac.then: - Network requests are minimized - Bundle size is optimized (< 50KB gzipped)

task.title: Add Domain Whitelist Section to WidgetSettings
task.description: Extend WidgetSettings component with "Allowed Domains" section including input field and domain list display.
task.acceptance: - "Allowed Domains" section added to WidgetSettings - Text input: "Enter domain (e.g., example.com, *.example.com)" - Add button or on-Enter handler - Error message area for validation errors - Domain list component showing all whitelisted domains as tags/chips - Each tag has delete (X) button - Hover states and smooth animations

task.title: Implement Domain Validation Function
task.description: Create validation function for domain format checking with regex or URL parsing.
task.acceptance: - Validate domain format (regex or URL parsing) - Accept: example.com, *.example.com, localhost, 127.0.0.1 - Reject: invalid formats, special characters - Reject duplicates (check against existing list) - Show validation errors inline

task.title: Add Empty Whitelist Warning Banner
task.description: Display warning when whitelist is empty indicating widget is publicly accessible.
task.acceptance: - Show yellow/amber banner when whitelist is empty - Message: "⚠️ No domain restrictions. Widget is publicly accessible on ANY website." - Use shadcn/ui Alert component - Include link to documentation on why to restrict domains

task.title: Update WidgetConfig Model with Domain Field
task.description: Add allowed_domains field to WidgetConfig model as JSON array.
task.acceptance: - Add field: allowed_domains: List[str] (JSON array) - PostgreSQL native JSON support - Max 50 domains per bot
task.database-migration: ALTER TABLE widget_configs ADD COLUMN allowed_domains JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb;

task.title: Update Widget Config Endpoints
task.description: Extend PUT endpoint to accept and validate allowed_domains array.
task.acceptance: - PUT /api/v1/bots/:bot_id/widget/config accepts allowed_domains: List[str] - Validate each domain: valid format, no duplicates - Max 50 domains per bot - Store in database as JSON array - Return updated config with domains list

task.title: Create Origin Verification Middleware
task.description: Implement middleware to verify Origin/Referer header against domain whitelist.
task.acceptance: - Middleware: @verify_widget_origin decorator - Extract Origin or Referer header from request - Load bot's allowed_domains from database - If list empty: allow all (no restrictions) - If list not empty: check if Origin/Referer matches whitelist - Support wildcard matching: *.example.com matches api.example.com - Return 403 Forbidden if not matched - Apply to chat query endpoints

task.title: Implement Domain Matching Logic
task.description: Create function to match origin against whitelist with wildcard support.
task.acceptance: - Function: matches_whitelist(origin, allowed_domains) returns bool - Support exact matching: example.com matches example.com - Support wildcard: *.example.com matches api.example.com, test.example.com - Wildcard does NOT match base domain (*.example.com doesn't match example.com) - Case-insensitive matching - Handle both Origin and Referer headers

task.title: Update Widget CSS for Mobile
task.description: Add mobile-first responsive CSS with proper breakpoints and touch-friendly sizing.
task.acceptance: - Chat window scales to device width (max 100vw) - Font sizes responsive: 14px on mobile, 16px on desktop - Button sizes: 44x44px minimum (WCAG touch target guideline) - Spacing: 8px minimum between clickable elements - Use CSS media queries or Tailwind responsive prefixes - Support 320px minimum width (iPhone SE)

task.title: Implement Mobile Keyboard Handling
task.description: Handle mobile keyboard appearance using visualViewport API to adjust chat window.
task.acceptance: - Use visualViewport API to detect keyboard presence - On keyboard show: scroll chat up so send button visible - On keyboard hide: reset scroll - Alternative: use window.innerHeight / window.visualViewport.height - Test on real iOS/Android devices

task.title: Add Viewport Meta Tag
task.description: Ensure proper viewport meta tag for responsive behavior on mobile devices.
task.acceptance: - HTML has viewport meta tag: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"> - Applied to both main website and widget iframe

task.acceptance: - Test: add valid domain (example.com) - Test: add wildcard domain (*.example.com) - Test: reject invalid format - Test: reject duplicate - Test: delete domain from list - Test: empty whitelist warning shown

dev-notes.note: Domain whitelisting MUST be enforced server-side (Origin/Referer check). Client-side checking is insufficient as users can modify widget code. Empty whitelist = no restrictions (backward compatible with Story 4.5).

Use visualViewport API for mobile keyboard handling. Fallback to window.innerHeight comparison for older browsers. Test on real iOS/Android devices as simulators don't accurately reflect keyboard behavior.
All touch targets MUST be >= 44x44px (WCAG 2.1 AAA guideline). Spacing between interactive elements >= 8px. Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 (WCAG AA). Test with VoiceOver (iOS) and TalkBack (Android).
Keep widget.js bundle < 50KB gzipped. Minimize network requests on mobile (batch, cache). Widget should load within 3 seconds on 3G connection.
